newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lank Vanik up on earnings prospects.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lank Vanik up on earnings prospects.

text.p: Shares of Investment bank Vanik Inc rose 2.3 percent, or 0.25 rupees, to 11.25 rupees on Monday on expectations of good interim results, brokers said.
"Investors believe interim results due shortly will be good after the company cut interest costs," said a broker.
Trade was active, with 8,000 shares changing hands.

Vanik, badly hit when interest costs rocketed in the second half of 1995 on rising T-bill rates, raised 150 million rupees through redeemable debentures in early 1996 to ease its reliance on short-term borrowing.
Analysts said investors also believed that Vanik's third-quarter performance would be even better after it sold five million shares in Puttalam Cement Co to Holderbank Financier Glarus Ltd.
